 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Sanjay Kumar, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Ajay Mishra, Addl Public Prosecuto

======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 23-03-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the Vigilance.
The petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 420,467,468,471/34B of the Indian Penal Code.
Prosecution case is that this petitioner in collusion with other accused persons got appointed teachers on the basis of forged and fabricated educational certificates.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.

Decision of appointing teachers was collective decision of the selection committee and the same was not taken by the petitioner individually who was Executive officer at the relevant Patna High Court CR.
There is no source to verify the authenticity of the education certificates of the candidates by the selection committee.
Petitioner has got no criminal antecedent.
Learned counsel for the Vigilance opposes the prayer for bail.
